disjoint: One reproducibly selected top-five physical seat per unique historical terrain. Blind opponents are selected by opaque strategy ID when available else exact public enrollment display name; hold one of each four ordered opponent identities separately within top-top/external. Additional known opponent holdout based on terrain hash. The underlying Sapling's entire historic exposure is not fully known; unseen claims refer to the fitted threat rule and these declared corpora. Exclude all original A's sixteen baseline terrains, the two predeclared fresh-development terrain hashes/seeds, and all their results.
observational: Use existing whole-corpus action-intent and official next-step UID outcomes once, via upstream verifier. Primary cohort moves NONE at a plant/seize eligible tile, actor cash>=quoted expense at decision. Distinguish realized payment, death, survival without payment; no inferential credit for being able to reach. Describe cash-short separately. Equal weight each physical map first, rates with denominators for near <=1 and far>1; cross-tab foe kind.
B: Shared A windows, original production prefix and affordable/collision feasibility; at the same selected root, only if A changed and predicted danger exceeds 0.50 choose parent, else choose A. Window still consumed. Define B risk=fitted probability of next-step death conditional on an actual affordable stay, map-equal within state/group. Groups = enemy collector/planter distance separately (0,1,>1), plant/seize. Beta shrinkage towards map-equal overall rate weighted equivalent to ten map observations split proportionally over represented groups. Compare to always-global and binary near-only distance calibration fitted on same primary all rows. No after-outcome input.
counterfactual: Evaluate independently official fixed-enemy one-step parent, existing A, and B for the identical first-eligible root/turn or no opportunity; both arms draw A's same joint except its one selected planter. Validate on 9 other source-parent maps (all original Master3s2), plus externally sampled 48 historic ladder boards rebuilt by exact Sapling parent through public prefix. Ladder generation actors and logged opponents are closed; opponent does not adapt over one submitted action. Include unchanged/no-root windows. Record directional protection, foregone successful purchases, actual treasury expense and counterexamples per opponent/map/seat. This does not estimate terminal U or win rate.
metrics: Map-equal Brier and log loss for held survival, classification counts and calibration for old baseline vs near-only vs B on actual stays; raw payment rates and per-opponent/per-map context. On exact matched A branch reports B-vs-A saved lives, forgone paid operations, and no-change/negative examples. No new original games. Never use the two future development maps or their scores to fit/reselect.
